passages.label: Written account of Elaine Torrance
passages.text: I was in my front room at number 41 when I heard the bang. I came out and there was a dark blue hatchback across the middle of the road with its front end damaged, and a silver car further up with its hazards on. The road was wet; it had been raining on and off all day. I did not see the collision itself, only what was there afterwards.
